description: C++ lets you write fast computer programs, including games and tools. Begin with a message and a few numbers. Then learn choices, loops, functions and lists. Later lessons explain classes and memory with small examples. These programs need a C++ compiler on your computer; the setup lesson shows how to get started.
versionNote: Targets C++20 as implemented by GCC 13+, Clang 16+ and Visual Studio 2022, with notes on the C++23 additions (std::print, std::expected, ranges::to) where they change everyday code.
whatYouWillLearn: Build and run a small C++ program
Use numbers, text, choices and loops
Keep values in lists and objects
Let smart pointers help look after memory
learningObjectives: Explain why C++ code needs a compiler
Print text and add whole numbers
Choose a step with an if statement

seo.title: C++ Tutorial: Learn with Small Steps
seo.description: Learn C++ with short programs about values, loops, functions, lists and classes. Find lessons, worked examples, practice and a word reference.
